title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. jaceoides
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. jaceoides, commonly known as Jurassic Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a possible treatment for various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Jurassic Hawkweed include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
